entities.name: An-Nasir Muhammad ibn Qaitbay
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: An-Nasir Muhammad ibn Qaitbay was the son of Qaitbay, and a Mamluk sultan of Egypt from 7 August 1496 to 31 October 1498, when he was assassinated.
